## Summary

Describe the user-visible behavior and why this change is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check:desktop`
- [ ] `npm run check:android`
- [ ] `npm run check:secrets`
- [ ] macOS behavior checked when affected
- [ ] Windows x64 behavior checked when affected
- [ ] Android device/emulator behavior checked when affected
- [ ] UI screenshots attached when visuals changed

## Safety

- [ ] No credentials, personal endpoints, retained audio, databases, or generated release files
- [ ] Existing settings/history migrations remain backward compatible
- [ ] Network or destructive behavior has focused failure-path tests
- [ ] Remaining platform-specific checks are stated explicitly
